savedAnalyses.advisoryText: Conditions look mostly good on this route, with only light disruption likely. As a rough rule of thumb, not a measured delay, leaving about 15 minutes early gives you a buffer. The strongest single factor was road grade. The weather used here is a live Open-Meteo forecast for the halfway point of your route. The model is split between neighbouring grades, so treat this as a rough guide.
